item.title: Mars in the 6th house: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Mars in the 6th house means Mars sat in the part of your chart that deals with work and routine when you were born. In astrology Mars stands for your drive and energy. You attack tasks, clear queues, and set a pace that reorganises whole offices around your output. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Neptune in the 1st house: what it means
item.description: Neptune in the 1st house means Neptune sat in the part of your chart that deals with self and beginnings when you were born. Read more at astralroots.app
